implementation.targetScope: The 16 root exports used by React DOM 19.3.1: cooperative deadline/priority queues, delayed work, continuation callbacks, cancellation, priority context, paint requests, yielding and host time. Test-only unstable_mock, experimental unstable_post_task, React Native and profiling builds are excluded.

changes: Zero runtime dependencies; no upstream runtime code copied or inspected. Public exports and black-box behavior are the compatibility controls.
Indexed heaps remove cancelled queued work immediately and cancel or reschedule obsolete delayed wakeups.
Self-cancellation suppresses a returned continuation, including when cancellation occurs synchronously inside the callback.
Long host waits are capped to avoid timer integer overflow. Invalid callbacks and infinite delays reject before acquiring host work.
Import does not create timers or message channels. Node/Bun use setImmediate; browsers lazily create a MessageChannel; timer fallback remains available.

caller.scope: Real React DOM transitions, urgent updates, Suspense retry, hydration, focus and cleanup. Source implementation does not imply app adoption or publication.
